Our Story

Elegance is a philosophy

🏛️
Founded in 2010

The Art of Dressing with Intention

Buchet di Eleganza was born from a passion for beauty and the belief that clothing can transform not just your appearance, but your spirit. Founded in Bucharest in 2010 by designer Irina Moldovan, our fashion house has grown from a small atelier into a European-recognized brand.


We work with the finest raw materials sourced from Italy, France, and Japan, combining traditional tailoring techniques with modern innovation.

Our Vision

To be Eastern Europe's leader in elegant fashion.

Our Mission

To create clothes that inspire confidence and admiration.

Our Values

Quality, integrity, creativity, sustainability.

Our Commitment

100% ethical materials and responsible production.
